meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 把纯文本或 Markdown 文件改写成结构清晰的 Markdown:补上 frontmatter(标题、摘要等)、标题层级、加粗、列表和代码块,并另存为“原文件名-formatted.md”,最后运行脚本修正标点和中英文间距。
howto.when: 当你提出“格式化 Markdown”“美化文章”等请求,或想改进文章排版时触发。

say.text: 帮我格式化这篇文章,输出成 Markdown 文件。
给这段纯文本加上标题、列表和加粗,补上摘要。
say.note: 会先识别内容类型,再整理保存。

say.text: 优化这个 Markdown 的排版,只修标点和间距。
say.note: 可选择只做排版修正,不生成副本。

howto.what_en: Turns plain text or Markdown into structured Markdown: adds frontmatter, headings, bold, lists, code blocks; saves as {filename}-formatted.md and runs a script fixing quotes and CJK/English spacing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "format markdown", "beautify article", or improve article layout.

say_en.text: Please format this article and output it as a Markdown file.
Add headings, lists, and bold to this plain text, and fill in a summary.
say_en.note: Detects content type, then reorganizes and saves.

say_en.text: Optimize this Markdown's layout, only fixing punctuation and spacing.
say_en.note: You can choose typography-only mode, no copy created.
